svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One LP-BTS decision
svg.desc: Three panels. First, the candidate charging stops induced by the live sensor geometry. Second, the learned graph policy concentrating thirty-two sampled stops. Third, budgeted tree search committing a single stop, whose charging radius covers a set of sensors that the charger then serves.
svg.text: a stop is a point, not a sensor and not a grid cell
K = 32 sampled stops become the planning support
p* charges every sensor within radius R: the set N(p*)
Schematic, not to scale. Each decision commits one stop; the universe is then rebuilt from the sensors still alive.
